summary.townHall_one: The heart of the city. Each level unlocks {{count, number}} more field slot outside the walls (from {{base}}) and lets the city hold one more valley. Beginner protection ends when the {{building}} reaches level {{level}}. It cannot be demolished.
summary.townHall_other: The heart of the city. Each level unlocks {{count, number}} more field slots outside the walls (from {{base}}) and lets the city hold one more valley. Beginner protection ends when the {{building}} reaches level {{level}}. It cannot be demolished.
summary.walls: Defends the city. Holds fortifications ({{forts}}) and builds them in a queue of one batch per level. In battle the walls absorb damage and extend the range of the {{tower}}.
summary.cottage: Houses people: raises the city's population limit. Population works the fields, pays tax and is spent to train troops.
summary.field: Produces {{resource}} and adds {{resource}} storage. Output and storage grow faster at higher levels; it needs workers from your idle population.
summary.warehouse: Hides resources from plunder. Each resource is protected up to the warehouse amount times the share you set for it (store percent).
summary.barracks: Trains troops. Each barracks has its own queue of one batch per level, and several barracks train in parallel.
summary.academy: Researches technologies, up to {{queues}} at a time. A technology only counts up to the {{building}} level in this city.
summary.inn: Offers heroes for hire. Higher levels offer more and stronger heroes; new offers cost {{gold}} gold per level.
summary.feastingHall: Houses heroes: one hero (hired or captured) per level.
summary.rallySpot_one: Sends armies out. Needed to march at all; each level allows {{count, number}} more army away at a time and {{troops}} more troops in each army (a {{item}} adds {{percent}}).
summary.rallySpot_other: Sends armies out. Needed to march at all; each level allows {{count, number}} more armies away at a time and {{troops}} more troops in each army (a {{item}} adds {{percent}}).
summary.marketplace_one: Trades food, lumber, stone and iron for gold with other players and the merchant. Each level allows {{count, number}} more waiting order.
summary.marketplace_other: Trades food, lumber, stone and iron for gold with other players and the merchant. Each level allows {{count, number}} more waiting orders.
summary.reliefStation: Speeds up armies (transports and reinforcements) marching between your own cities.
summary.beaconTower: Watches for enemies: level 1 shows the troops of hostile armies marching on you, level 2 also their hero.
summary.embassy: Needed to join an alliance (accept an invitation or apply).
summary.prerequisite: Needed for what it unlocks below; it has no other effect yet.

placement.unique: One per city, in its own slot.
placement.inside: Inside the walls; as many as you like.
placement.insideLimited: Inside the walls; at most {{limit}} per city.
placement.outside: Outside the walls (field slots); as many as you like.
placement.outsideLimited: Outside the walls (field slots); at most {{limit}} per city.

effect.townHall_other: {{slots}} field slots, up to {{count, number}} valleys
effect.walls_one: {{space}} fortification space, {{count, number}} queued batch, {{hitPoints}} wall hit points, +{{percent}} tower range
effect.walls_other: {{space}} fortification space, {{count, number}} queued batches, {{hitPoints}} wall hit points, +{{percent}} tower range
effect.field_one: {{amount}} {{resource}}/h at full labour, +{{storage}} storage, employs {{count, number}} worker
effect.field_other: {{amount}} {{resource}}/h at full labour, +{{storage}} storage, employs {{count, number}} workers

effect.inn_other: {{count, number}} hero offers, heroes up to level {{level}}

effect.rallySpot_other: {{count, number}} armies out at once, up to {{troops}} troops each
